title: Fix jmap-vtc-e2ee-guide.md: garbled text + MLS PCS/FS conflation + fingerprint encoding
description: MUST-FIX: (1) Line 277: garbled/corrupted/truncated text. Needs manual inspection and rewrite. (2) MLS post-compromise security conflated with forward secrecy. These are distinct RFC 9420 properties: FS protects past messages if current key is compromised; PCS ensures that after a compromise, security is eventually restored when the compromised party updates their key material. The guide conflates them, which will mislead E2EE implementers. SHOULD-FIX: (3) Fingerprint encoding unspecified. The guide discusses fingerprint verification but never specifies the encoding format (hex? base64? emoji hash like Signal's safety numbers?). Implementers need an interoperable format to display fingerprints.
close_reason: All issues fixed across 11 VTC files
